subject.title: [Bug]: App replacement handoff retries forever under load

question: After authenticated replacement handoff retries are exhausted, should OpenClaw exit to let a verified KeepAlive supervisor start the replacement, or retain the old app and surface one actionable fault?
rationale: Both outcomes can be safe, but they differ in availability and operator expectations for supervised and unsupervised installations; the report explicitly presents both as acceptable alternatives.

options.title: Exit for verified supervisor
options.body: After bounded retries, stop monitoring and exit only when the deployment contract confirms a KeepAlive supervisor will relaunch the installed replacement.

options.title: Keep old app running
options.body: After bounded retries, retain the old trusted process and emit a single actionable fault until a later explicit replacement attempt.

options.title: Support both by deployment mode
options.body: Use the verified supervisor state to choose exit versus retain-old behavior, with a documented fallback for unsupervised apps.

recommendation.title: Exit for verified supervisor
recommendation.body: After bounded retries, stop monitoring and exit only when the deployment contract confirms a KeepAlive supervisor will relaunch the installed replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: The current reporter and assignee supplied the deployment assumptions that determine the intended terminal behavior.
